model: ideal stoichiometric rocksalt B1 AFM-II along [111], four-atom magnetic cell; two oppositely polarized Fe sites and two O sites

lattice_source.reported: rocksalt AFM-II calculations at experimentally reported FeO lattice parameter 4.334 Å
lattice_source.citation: S. Mandal et al., Systematic beyond-DFT study of binary transition metal oxides, npj Computational Materials 5, 115 (2019), DOI 10.1038/s41524-019-0251-7

magnetic_model_source.reported: AFM-II along [111], with two transition-metal ions in the magnetic cell
magnetic_model_source.citation: S. Mandal et al., Systematic beyond-DFT study of binary transition metal oxides, npj Computational Materials 5, 115 (2019), DOI 10.1038/s41524-019-0251-7

stoichiometry_caveat.reported: near-stoichiometric Fe0.9347O diffraction; do not treat ideal FeO as a universal low-temperature phase
stoichiometry_caveat.citation: S. Stølen et al., On the Crystallographic and Magnetic Structures of Nearly Stoichiometric Iron Monoxide, Journal of Solid State Chemistry 124 (1996) 52-57, DOI 10.1006/jssc.1996.0206

deviations: Unrelaxed ideal stoichiometric rocksalt AFM-II transfer model. Real wüstite is commonly nonstoichiometric and near-stoichiometric low-temperature samples may show additional structural/magnetic complexity; this campaign does not model vacancy ordering or monoclinic distortions.
